name: Kaneshiro Goushi
source:
Among the other members, he has the strongest desire to be an artist. He has a foul mouth and is quick to say what he thinks, so he often clashes with the other members, but he also has a caring side and is admired by his juniors.

He is a returnee and studied abroad before his debut.

[Translated from [url=http://www.bprogame.com/member/#kaneshirogoshi]official website[/url]]
